description: We’re Team SkyBurn, building a web app that harmonizes MODIS and VIIRS fire hotspot data into one clear burning-activity calendar. Our skills: software development, web development, and AI. We’re looking for teammates with Earth Science knowledge, Data Visualization skills, or a Designer to help make our dashboard look great. If you’re into satellite data, wildfires, or just want to build something impactful — join us!
